ann.title: Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/09/2026

news.title: Sin Heng Chan Q3 FY2026 Profit Before Tax Falls 75.1% to RM0.75 Million, No Dividend Declared

recent_en: SHCHAN has released its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 and continued to disclose monthly production figures. News reported that its Q3 FY2026 profit before tax fell 75.1% year-on-year to RM0.75 million, with no dividend declared.
notable_en: Announced consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
News reported Q3 FY2026 profit before tax fell 75.1% year-on-year to RM0.75 million, with no dividend declared.
risks_en: Q3 FY2026 profit before tax declined 75.1% year-on-year.
